scope: Group-level evidence progression. Does not relabel all individual parameters as calibrated.

layout.title: Capacities and initial conditions
layout.finding: Capacities and geometry are designs; select an internally compatible reference package before sizing conclusions.

thermal.title: Reactor heat and operating envelope
thermal.finding: New digitized response benchmark; ambient losses, coolant exchange, startup and aged catalyst must be separated.

chemistry.title: Stoichiometry and product boundary
chemistry.finding: Molecular weights and gas enthalpies quantified. Feed enthalpy is consequential; ideal conversion remains explicit.

electrolyser.title: Electrolyser system performance
electrolyser.finding: Raw-data fit complete. Plant transfer requires AC/DC, cooling, purification and standby boundaries.

battery.title: Battery losses and power limits
battery.finding: Near-scale published cycle curve reproduced; raw SCADA and current fixture chemistry not matched.

gas-storage.title: Gas buffers and deliveries
gas-storage.finding: Density check points verified; usable pressure heel quantified. Compressor, vaporizer and purchase design still open.

solar.title: PV conversion and clipping
solar.finding: Held-out temperature model fitted; back temperature not cell junction, no site yield or shading validation.

weather.title: Weather provenance and forecast availability
weather.finding: No new weather bias fit. Add rain/wind and calibrate lead-time errors with chronologically withheld seasons; reanalysis is not measured plant output.

sensing.title: Measurement uncertainty and diagnosis
sensing.finding: Accuracy floors and span/temperature/drift terms now explicit; fault probabilities and residual covariance remain unmeasured.

faults.title: Fault lifecycle and incidence
faults.finding: Failures have cause-specific persistence and recovery. No defensible modern fleet incidence rate extracted.

cleaning.title: Cleaning physics and environmental limits
cleaning.finding: European soiling evidence and equipment rates available; exact site deposition/removal and permanent damage not fitted.

inspection.title: Inspection channels and references
inspection.finding: Inspection success and intervention are distinct. Observation detection confusion matrices not yet calibrated.

recovery.title: Recovery and intervention capability
recovery.finding: Bounded actuation/cleaning/calibration are not generic equipment repair. No autonomous PEM stack swap evidence.

support.title: Support system and access
support.finding: Explicit utilities, geometry, charging, operators and sampling lag replace generic support budgets in reference designs.

maintenance.title: Reliability and routine maintenance
maintenance.finding: Avoid mixing cycle reliability, active-time failure and calendar intervention; no universal repair success or lead time.

economics.title: Prices, allocations and decision economics
economics.finding: Dated European capacity-specific costs provide benchmark; no 450kW installed quote or field-robot service contract inferred.

control.title: Objectives and planning approximations
control.finding: Risk preferences, minimum run and horizon are policies unless named equipment imposes them. Test utility after calibrated observation/boundary changes.

coupling.title: Plant electrical and temporal boundary
coupling.finding: Support electricity, pressure heels, feed enthalpy and evidence arrival all compete with production.

experiment.title: Reproducibility and comparison settings
experiment.finding: Keep fixed seeds, publication boundaries and paired weather; parameter calibration split separate from policy evaluation split.
